ordered_diagnoses: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ with pseudohorn cysts

s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end of the tumor
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: The patient is a man in his mid-80s
The left lower eyelid mass has been present for 4 years
The mass has recently grown and acquired a crust
The tumor is well-circumscribed and measures 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Microscopic findings include hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts
Neoplastic squamous cells are present with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures are present in the malignant squamous cells
The tumor involves many hairs and has areas of clear cell change
